performance.verdict: Campaigns dark 12 days; GBP holding but intake pipeline shows zero opportunity conversion.

findings.text: Meta spend has been $0 for 12 consecutive days (Aug 6–17), zeroing out all paid leads; no budget exhaustion or pause reason surfaced in data.
GHL shows 33 contacts but 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments in the 28-day window — leads that arrived pre-pause are not converting through intake.
GBP actions fell 23.4% last 7d and IG reach collapsed 98.76% vs prior 7d, suggesting organic support also weakened during the paid blackout.
Pre-pause CPL baseline was $26.04 over 28 days on 45 leads; the active period (Jul 21–Aug 5) showed CPL ranging roughly $17–$26, a workable floor to defend on reactivation.
GA4 sessions spiked to 206 on Aug 13 and held elevated (54–80) through Aug 15 despite zero paid spend — source unknown; directional only due to known JCL double-count issue.

suggestions.text: Restore Meta campaigns immediately — 12 days dark with confirmed $0 spend is a hard stop on all lead flow.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spend has been $0 since Aug 6 — 12 consecutive dark days confirmed in the series. Reactivate 'CROA || CBO - 3/17/26' (top spender at $621.70 over the prior 28-day window) at its last active daily budget (~$69/day based on Aug 5 spend). Success check: at least 3 leads generated within 72 hours of reactivation at CPL ≤ $26.04 (28-day baseline). Confirm reactivation by 2026-08-19.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake: 33 contacts exist but 0 opportunities created — fix pipeline stage mapping or follow-up workflow before new leads arrive.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 33 contacts with 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments in the 28-day window, meaning leads are entering but not progressing through intake. Review pipeline stage automation and contact-to-opportunity conversion workflow in GHL before campaigns go live. Success check: at least 1 opportunity created per 5 new contacts within the first week post-reactivation. Resolve by 2026-08-20.

suggestions.text: Watch GA4 session spike (206 on Aug 13) — confirm source before attributing to organic or any new channel.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 recorded an unexplained spike of 206 sessions on Aug 13 against a baseline of 20–54 sessions/day, with no paid spend active. Due to the known JCL GA4 double-count issue this is directional only. Check traffic source/medium breakdown in GA4 for Aug 13 to identify origin. Re-check on 2026-08-21 after campaigns reactivate to isolate paid vs organic baseline.
